decisions.source: #385 user story 27 + Out of Scope (question number not preserved)
decisions.text: User story 27: ordinary tests run without Node and report what to install when a selected formatter lacks dependencies. Out of Scope: automatic Node/npm installation; the product must not install formatter packages on demand.

A manual binding path resolves from the configured root, or from pytest rootdir when none is set; a completely empty NDJSON stream is an error; an explicitly bound .feature.md without a Feature declaration is an error; one failing test does not by itself make the shared Allure stage broken, and real session-finish errors are surfaced.

Manual binding uses the configured root, falling back to pytest rootdir. The full reproducible Messages audit with probe execution and coverage checks belongs to the product and may be invoked by the harness.
A .feature.md without a Feature declaration is an error both for an explicit binding and for automatic discovery.
Every step marked @not_implemented is an error by default; skip mode is selected explicitly. A marked step must not succeed in error mode. The previous success-without-execution mode is not restored.
A plain .feature file without a Feature declaration is an error. An empty directory and a Feature header with no scenarios are separate cases.
In error mode the body of a @not_implemented step is not executed and the scenario fails immediately with a clear error; in skip mode the body is also not executed.
A scenario-local tolerant policy takes precedence over the global setting, including the CLI. An explicitly allowed error stays visible and the scenario may continue.

Allure compatibility is defined by the supported format and verified against real Allure 2/3; the old design schema is not a separate mandatory contract and is updated or replaced when it conflicts with actual compatibility.

decisions.text: Source-code architecture evaluation, its prose descriptions, and the entity-to-score mapping belong to the Development Harness; they are stored there and updated on request. Architecture scores and score descriptions are not stored next to product sources.
The architecture mapping with scores and score descriptions is versioned in the private harness repository, not a separate score-history system; only current scores are authoritative.
